record.question: John was promoted as officer at a __________ date.
record.explanation: Answer C: later. Later fits “at a later date” (C). Independent check: “Later” is the comparative adjective meaning at a subsequent date; “latter” refers to the second of two items, while “late/last” do not fit this meaning. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/later-latter-or-latest-last. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
